planDelta: Four knobs moved, each out of a floor it was sitting exactly on: openWindLeadMs 434 -> 467, openMaskLeadMs 300 -> 349, maskOnMs 4400 -> 4449, windLeadMs 10550 -> 10570 with windMs 3250 -> 3230 so the hold still ends clear of the camdrop. The emitted night-5 plan moves the opening wind +2050 -> +2083, the opening camdrop +3800 -> +3833, the opening mask +4400 -> +4482, the loop wind +10550 -> +10570 and the loop mask +14400 -> +14449. whyItMoved: MONITOR_MASK_READY_MS was `MONITOR_ANIM_DOWN_MS + MIN_CONTACT_MS` = 400 and its own comment said it was 'the +400 ms timing used by the Night 5 route'. The route pressed the mask at exactly +400, so `400 < 400` is false and the compile passed in silence, and test-artifact-animation-gates.mjs pinned that boundary as correct. On the phone the mask press was graded MISSING with the monitor observably down on about one cycle in eight, and because a corrected cycle's mask window is 4000 ms instead of 4800 ms, every correction handed a vent occupant a free pass against the five continuous mask ticks that Balloon Boy, Mangle and Toy Chica all share. The floor is now anchored to the native frame trace that measured the mask button absent through 322 ms, faint at ~337 ms and fully visible at ~382.5 ms: ceil(382.5 + 33) = 416.
bounds: no new transport measurement was taken for this binding: it reuses the transport qualified on 2026-09-06 and re-bound on 2026-09-07, 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-11, whose UHID receipt delay was measured at p50 4-5 ms, max 13 ms over 200 events. What is new is the plan text. No claim beyond DEVICE_MEASURED transport qualification; in-game menu navigation stays limited to the measured title-model items; the save cursor was observed at Night 5 before this binding.

If the seam hypothesis is right the CORRECTED gate rate should fall from the ~13% that reproduced across two runs; if it does not fall, the hypothesis is refuted and the target is elsewhere
